facts.fact: AU: proof of freedom to marry
facts.value: Some countries ask Australians to prove they are not already married; the most common documents are a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage (CNI) or certificates from a registry of births, deaths and marriages.
facts.notes: Smartraveller, last updated 18 Aug 2026; fetched 28 Oct 2026. Unchanged in substance since 15 Oct.

facts.fact: AU: where the CNI is issued
facts.value: DFAT can issue a CNI in Australia, but some local authorities only accept CNIs issued in their own country, so couples should ask the destination's embassy whether they need one, whether it can be issued in Australia and whether it needs an apostille.
facts.notes: Smartraveller 28 Oct 2026. Neither page says which applies to Portugal (see F041).

facts.value: At least one applicant must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident; DFAT issues CNIs through Australian Passport Offices, Australian embassies and consulates overseas, and by mail; fees apply and rise with CPI on 1 January each year.
facts.notes: Smartraveller CNI page, last updated 1 Oct 2026 (changed since 15 Oct: adds the CPI note and the 'you may not need a CNI' step). No fee figure for the page.

facts.value: An overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law.

facts.fact: UK: FCDO service for proof of freedom to marry
facts.value: Some countries ask for documents proving you are free to marry, such as a certificate of no impediment or a marital status affirmation; the FCDO online service shows which you might need and lets you apply and pay, and you need a valid British passport to use it.
Use exactly: Wedded Wonderland, Wedded Concierge, Wedded Advisor, Wedded Privileges. 'Wonderland Luxury Advisor' and lower-case 'Wedded advisor' are not brand names.
Enquiries route to Wedded Concierge (config enquiry_route 'wedded-concierge', endpoint /api/concierge/enquiry); pages show no venue or supplier contact details.
facts.notes: Live page links to /wonderland-concierge; Technical SEO to confirm the live concierge path.

facts.value: Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance.
facts.source: Existing published claim on the live page (current.md: "Wedded Concierge pairs you with advisors ... from the first enquiry to the last dance")
facts.notes: Use this wording only; do not add markets, numbers or capabilities.

facts.fact: Weekend inclusions can include a coordinator
facts.value: A Portugal wedding weekend planned through Wedded Concierge can include an on-the-day coordinator.
facts.source: User's section plan, research doc section 4 row 6 (inclusions list names a coordinator)
facts.notes: Write as 'can include', never as a guarantee (D15).
